A tray with a burger, fries, and a yellow drink sits between them. (2) The boy reaches for the drink, but the girl quickly pulls it away and drinks from the straw while still focusing on her phone. The boy watches her with a slightly disappointed look but continues to chew his own food. (3) The girl suddenly drops her phone, lunges across the table, and grabs the burger. She takes a massive, aggressive bite out of it. The boy looks shocked and wide-eyed. As she eats, she uses her free hand to shove the boy's face away while he makes muffled protesting gestures.
